balls.text: short outside off, tries to slam that over point, gets a thick edge to third man and he scrambles back to complete the second
makes room and Roach gets that in the blockhole, Agarkar digs it out back to the bowler
short, bowled at 141.8 kmph, tries to pull it through square leg, is hit on the arm, gets a single
full on the off, Saha drills it past Roach and past mid-off, who's inside the circle, for another boundary
moves away and drives it wide of extra cover for a single
short and wide, and Agarkar moves away to slash that through point for a boundary, this is already a formidable score
poor ball, full toss on leg stump, Saha shuffles and helps it on its way past short fine leg for a boundary
was that a catch? Nope, it landed just short of Ojha as he dived forward, full and Agarkar placed it straigh to him but he picked it on the half-volley and admitted it
fullish on the off, driven to long-off for a single

Sunil Gavaskar on Tv commentary said "That's a big one", it was nowhere near being that in the end, lands on a length on the off, tried to smash that over long-off but mistimed it, Gibbs had no trouble snapping it yards inside the ropes
gets a boundary this time, full and wide, makes room and slices it over point
slower one bowled full outside off, Angelo strikes it well but can't get much elevation, straight into the palms of Gibbs at long-off
yorker length on the off, dug out towards point for a single
makes room and swats that past extra cover into the deep for a couple of runs
full outside off, almost yorker length, makes room and steers it to point, that's all he can do
freehit coming, a big no-ball, shortish outside off, swing and a miss but he'll get another chance the next ball
short on middle, fends it away into the leg side for a single
driven towards long-on for a single
Roach pitches it up and Hussey takes full toll, getting under it and depositing it over long-off for a maximum, the 150 comes up
holes out in the deep, the shot was on, on middle and on a length, Ganguly was in position to send that into the stands but connect this as well as he had the earlier ones, found Rohit in the deep
Ganguly's on fire, full toss by Ojha and Ganguly shovels that gift ball over deep midwicket, the crowd is delirious, long time coming
Ojha is struggling, tried to get him stumped again off a wide ball  but Ganguly's not falling for it, it's called by the umpire
Ganguly has spoiled Ojha's figures here, flighted on middle and he swings it miles over deep square leg, took it from a length and punished it
full and wide, saw him coming down and fired it wide but Ganguly got back into his crease in time
massive, turning into him and he bends low to sweep that powerfully over the deep backward square leg boundary for a big six
spun away after pitching on leg stump, goes for the slog-sweep, is struck on the pads as it turns away, steals a leg bye
another missed stumping, beaten by the turn there, landed outside leg stump, Hussey came down the track but couldn't get his bat to it as it turned away, he missed and so did Gilchrist
short, pulled away to deep square leg for a single to keep the strike
comes down the track and slaps it towards deep square leg for one more
mixing it up with those offpsinners, Ganguly had shaped up for a big one but had to adjust with that shortish delivery, played it towards cover
turned away through midwicket for a single
seemed to be the slower one, flighted it and Hussey came down the track, took it of the half-volley and hammered it over Symonds' head for a flat six
short of a good length on middle, played back to the bowler
similar delivery but Ganguly gets to it this time, steering it through point for a couple
missed stumping, that's what it appeared to be, made room as he stepped out of the track, Venu slipped it wide, Ganguly stretched, missed and Gilchrist couldn't collect it on the full
nicely placed, drove it gently into that big gap between long-off and deep cover for a couple of ruins
Ganguly continues to attack, made room and Venu chased him, took it from a length and smacked it over the bowler's head for a one-bounce four
shortish on the off, pushed from the crease to extra cover, steals a quick run
full on the off, driven through the line to long-off for a single
makes room and drives that down the ground to long-off for one more
clipped away behind square for a single
short outside off, holds its line as it is dropped short, goes for the cut, can't connect, given a wide
driven hard past the bowler for a single to long-off
tossed up on the off, drilled past the bowler towards long-on where Gibbs slides to keep them down to a single
full on the off, cracked hard but straight to deep cover for a single
flighted outside off, Hussey is happy giving strike to his captain, played to deep midwicket
he's taking charge now, flighted on middle, steps out of the crease and smashes that over the bowler's head for a one-bounce four
brings up his fifty in style, full toss from Ojha, a rare lapse and Ganguly deposits that over the ropes behind deep midwicket, thumped it, a much-needed release for his team
flicked away towards fine leg for a single
Gangs goes after that one, flighted on the off, charged down and swung it away towards deep square leg, didn't time it too well, just a single
shortish on leg stump, whips it behind square for a single
shortish on middle, gets on the back foot and defends to cover
shortish on the off and cuts away with some extra bounce to beat the outside edge as Ganguly tries to cut that
driven down the ground to long-off for a single
brushes the pads and rolls down behind Gilchrist for a leg bye
that was the offspinner, change of pace, pitched outside leg and turned in to rap him on the pads as he tried to turn the face, big appeal for lbw but rightly turned down
full on middle and leg, flicked through square leg for one more
full outside off, steered towards point, no run there
pushed through the line to long-off for one more, another tidy over from Ojha
flighted on leg stump, clipped to square leg
fired in full on middle, came down the track and chipped it towards long-on for a single
kept it flat and bowled it short on the off, chopped it to point
pushed down the ground towards long-on for one more
flighted on leg stump, turned wide of square leg
bowls it on a good length outside off, gets forward and square-drives it wide of a diving point for a couple of runs in the deep, good over for Kolkata
delicate touches there, sliding on the pads, Ganguly knows his field, there is a short fine in place and he glances it well wide of him to beat him to the ropes
fullish on the off, crunches it towards Symonds at extra cover
short and wide again, repeats the lapse, Ganguly breaks the shackles by smacking it through point for a boundary, Jaskaran could have done better to stop that
short outside off, Ganguly reaches to play the cut, misses
full outside off, struck sweetly but straight to extra cover
gets across and taps it behind square for a single, excellent start by Ojha
shortish on the off, waits for it to turn in and drops it into the leg side
flighted on middle, turned it wide of mid-on for a single

strikes almost immediately, came round the wicket and bowled it flat on the off, held its line and he bent low to play the sweep, inside-edged it on to the stumps, he;s been their form batsman and that counts as a big blow
gets a stride out and defends it to extra cover
looping it on middle and leg, gets forward and defends it into the leg side
tossed up on the off from round the wicket, driven straight to extra cover
flighted on the off, gets across and drives it towards deep midwicket for a single, some alert fielding in the deep keeps them down to a single
flighted on the off, driven through to long-off for a single
cut away, short outside off, waited for it to turn away and cut it through the vacant point region for another four, he's going well here
closes the face on that one and tickles it wide of square leg for a single
tossed up on middle, is swept really fine for a couple wide of fine leg
banged it hard on the pitch on middle, got back, nicely behind it, and defended it to cover
short delivery down the leg side, can't clip it fine but earns a wide
four more, quick, at 144 kmph, landed on a good length outside off, Ganguly opened the face at the right time and third man, despite the dive, failed to prevent that from getting to the ropes
beautifully struck, made room and Roach tried to chase him, short of a good length and he struck that through the line over long-on, clean hit and cleared the ropes comfortably
the offcutter, shortish on the off stump, worked away off the back foot through square leg for a single
short on the off, moves away and cuts it towards Rohit at point who dives and fumbles to allow a single
shortish on middle, gets on the back foot and drops it to the leg side
Pujara's stay ends, closed the face on that a little too early, bowled on a good length on middle, it held its line, got a leading edge straight to Pragyan Ojha at mid-off
slower one bowled short on the off, cut away to point and steals a quick single
Ganguly takes the risk, full outside off, Ganguly made room and crashed that just over extra cover for a boundary, didn't clear him by much
in the channel outside off, eased towards deep cover for a single
short of a good length on the off at 111.5 kmph, pushed off the back foot wide of mid-on, the single is averted
115 kmph, on middle and leg, Pujara tries to tickle it fine but is struck on the pads, would have slid down
full outside off, shows 121 kmph, more believable, tries to drive it hard through cover, gets an inside edge wide of the keeper
slower one this time, bowled short on middle, the speedometer shows 130 kmph, I don't believe it, pulled away to deep midwicket for a single
four more, short and wide, a poor ball, there is a short third man in place but Pujara slashes it well over the fielder to pick up another boundary
too wide down the leg side, even a dive from Gilchrist can't save it, five runs just gifted away
short of a good length on the off, pushed towards mid-off
fullish delivery, steered it past point into the deep for a single
short of a length and Ganguly slashes hard at that one, misses

close call, brilliant fielding by Symonds at mid-off, it's driven well and he dives full length to his right, picks it up and aims at the non-striker's end and misses by a whisker, would have been close
guided down to third man for a single

angling on the pads and it;s driven straight to midwicket, some hesitation out in the middle as Pujara kept running for a single while Ganguly stayed rooted to the non-striker's end, the trigger was a misfield at midwicket and he dropped his bat in the middle of the match, no damage done in the end as he was sent back in time
well struck, a juicy half-volley and Pujara rams it towards cover where a dive from Rohit Sharma saves a couple of runs, dived to his left and kept them down to a couple
short of a good length outside off, lets it alone to the keeper
full on the pads again, failed to get it fine, flicks his pads and rolls wide of square leg, they get a leg bye
four more, poor delivery by Symonds, spoils the over with a full delivery down the leg side and Pujara helps it on its way to the fine-leg boundary
nice start for Pujara, short and wide and he makes sure he cashes in, cuts it hard past a diving point to the boundary
bowled it short on leg stump, whipped it past square leg for a single
tight line, slightly short on middle, pushed back to the bowler

Gayle goes, this is a slow pitch and it took forever to get to him, short of a good length on middle, Gayle had made up his mind, made room and tried to slap that over long-off but didn't time it well enough, found Kemar Roach in the deep who took a comfortable catch, early strike for Deccan
bowling seam-up, short of a good length on the off, guided to point
swinging in again, targeting the blockhole again, Ganguly stays rooted to the crease and digs it out towards point
sliding on the pads again, an opportunity missed for Gayle who didn't connect to place it wide of short fine, clipped the pads and they get a single
bowls it on a good length outside off, Gayle tries to smash that through the line, didn't move much, was attempting a stand and deliver shot but missed
getting it to swing in but straying on the pads, full and Gayle flicks it wide of short fine leg for his first boundary
the speedometer clocked that at 133 kmph though it didn't appear to be that quick, full on middle and leg, aiming for the blockhole there, Gayle digs it out to mid-on
gets it to move in to Gayle, lands on a good length on middle and leg, turned away to midwicket
bowled it short, an attempted bouncer, Ganguly appeared to take his eyes off that one as he went for the pull but connected well, got it wide of square leg into the deep for a couple
shortish, bowled at 138 kmph, rocked back to pull it through square but it came on to him a little too quickly, was struck on the arm and it lobbed up and fell in front of the keeper
cuts down on the width, shortish again but Ganguly doesn't have much room, gets on the back foot and defends it to cover
short and wide, stands tall and cuts it hard through a diving point for four more, the crowd is up
short of a good length outside off, leaving the left hander there, allows it through
off the mark in style, full on the pads and he clips it delightfully over square leg for a boundary, confident start
in the blockhole outside off, doesn't dig it out, a dot ball to finish things off, Kolkata get a fourth win under their belt
finally, but too late, in the slot on middle and he clears long-on comfortably
Symonds' struggle ends, full and quick outside off, makes room to crash that over long-off, miscues it to Kartik who runs to his right from point and takes a simple catch
driven down the ground to long-off for one more
comes down the track and rams it down to long-off on the bounce for just a single
just a single and the crowd knows this game is virtually over, driven to deep midwicket
another superb over, finishes off with just a couple, driven wide of long-off
another one, tight line, bowled on a good length on the off, strikes it back to Bond, big cheers from the crowd
failing to get them away, short on middle, tries to swat that past the bowler, ends up playing it straight back to him, dot balls galore
mixing it up very well, it takes some wily bowling to keep Symonds in check, the slow legcutter there, he didn't pick it and missed, another dot ball
trying an inswinging yorker there, moves away to steer it past point but it's fuller than he would have liked, misses
low full toss and he connects well, strikes it cleanly over the bowler's head wide of long-off for a one bounce four, first four since the 14th over says the TV commentator, took a while to come
gets the yorker in, in the blockhole outside off, can only dig it out towards long-off, just the single, Kolkata in control, another tidy over
full toss again and they're struggling to get rid of them, chopped  into the off side in front of point
fullish delivery, turning out to be a good over, drives it to extra cover where Gayle fields at the edge of the circle, just one
targeting the blockhole, a low full toss, moves across and drives it towards deep midwicket for a couple more
wide, well outside off, Symonds had shaped up for a big one there and wisely left it alone
full toss, a low one this time, tries to swing it over midwicket, gets an inside edge to square leg, just a single
starts with a full toss but only a single given away, Symonds is upset with himself, could only manage to punch it to extra cover
excellent over, yorker length on the off, dug out wide of midwicket for a well-run couple but no boundaries conceded, pressure on Symonds
short and slow on the off, punches it back to Mathews who fields it well on his follow through, moving to his left
good bowling, low full toss on the off stump, drives it to long-off, just one run, Kolkata won't mind this at all
short outside off, makes room and slaps it wide of deep extra cover, just a couple though
almost in the blockhole, all Symonds can do is drive it to extra cover, he refuses the single
short on the off, pulled away but mistimed to long-on for a single
going down the leg side, but he chooses to play at it, wide of short fine for a single to keep the strike
comes down the track and drives it down the ground to long-on
pushed away wide of midwicket for a single

gone! Short of a good length on leg stump and turned towards middle, Rohit was trying to work it into the leg side, missed it due to the turn, the ball clipped his thighs on the way to the stumps, and he's consumed three dot balls
shortish on leg and turning towards middle and off, plays it back onto the pitch, the pressure builds, the crowd cheers
shortish on leg stump, played it straight back to the bowler
short of a good length on the off, punched in the direction of mid-on for an easy single
makes room and Bond follows him, worked to midwicket
the legcutter again, fullish outside off, runs it down to third man for a single
wide down the leg side
clips it wide of square leg for a single

Gibbs, oh Gibbs, slower one again and he has a rush of blood, makes room, takes that from a length and sends ir straight into the palms of long-off, well struck but not well enough, ends another threatening stand just like Mishra had done earlier
slower legcutter, gets a nick as he tries to guide it to third man, gets to the keeper on the bounce
Gibbs gets to his half-century with a gentle nudge behind square, one of his more restrained Twenty20 fifties but he's dropped anchor and they have plenty of wickets in hand
dabbed into the off side wide of cover for a single
they're getting the boundaries with ease here, short outside off and he has no trouble dispatching it through point and beating the sliding Hussey in the deep
holds back the length this time, had shaped up for a powerful shot but restrained himself, defending it back to the bowler
a full toss, another one, on middle and he thumps that over midwicket for another boundary, some nerves for Kolkata
Parmar slips in a doosra which is cut away for four, short outside off and turns away, Symonds makes room and slashes it past Gayle at point, he gives chase but can't drag it back

is that a beamer? Harper isn't quite sure standing at square leg. Marginal call, as the replay indicates, guides it to short third for a single, will that be given a no-ball, doubt it, it's not given, Symonds keeps the strike for the next over
full toss and this time Symonds ensures he dismisses it, wide outside off and he opens the face to steer it through point for a welcome boundary
full on the off, length delivery, smacked to long-on for a single
a bit of reverse there, good length on the off, driven to long-off for one more
short ball, slower one, at 118 kmph, pulled to deep midwicket for a single
full toss outside off, smashed to deep point for a single
flighted on the off, gets forward and drives that to long-off
crunched down to long-on for a single
dropped, sharp chance, was absolutely hammered back to the bowler, a low full toss and it comes back straight at him, Parmar is late to react, turning to his left, and spills that
turned behind square for a single
went the other way, the doosra, Symonds could have hit it anywhere but chose to drag it in ugly fashion to long-on
flighted outside off, comes down the track and drives it hard back to the bowler
shortish on the off, waits and slams it straight to extra cover, nicely building up for the surge now
in the blockhole on the off, dug out towards point for a quick single
slower one bowled short on the off, pulled to long-on for one more
low full toss on middle, flicked towards Bond at short fine who slides and keeps them to a single
slower one, slaps it past extra cover who misfields, two more
short of a length on the off, cracked off the back foot to deep cover
pushed back watchfully to the bowler
tries ti sweep that fine, clips the pads and they steal a leg bye
lovely placement, lands on a good length, makes room and lofts it over extra cover, beats that gap between long-off and deep extra, four runs
shortish on middle, drops it into the on side in front of Agarkar running in from deep square leg, two more
fullish on middle, driven through square leg into the deep for a single
angling in towards middle, eases it towards deep cover for a single
bowled it short outside off, tried to cut that behind point, a slower one again and he waited for it this time but still couldn't connect
slower one bowled short outside off, Symonds looks to cut that through point, misses
full toss on the off, driven through to long-off for a single

Mishra at the other end has gifted a wicket, that shot clearly lacked intent, slightly short and he simply struck that through the line, lofting it straight to Tiwary at long-on who hardly had to move

dropped, didn't react quickly enough, fullish on middle and Gibbs just pushes it back towards Mathews who slips in his follow through and though he gets his right hand to that one, he can't quite hold on, how costly will that prove?
short on the off, pulled away towards deep square leg, the crowd has gone silent
short of a length on the off, comes down the track and crunches that to long-off for one more
bowled it full outside off, driven hard to deep cover, just the single
two more, short on middle and leg, jabbed it through midwicket, long-on takes a while to get to it and they grab a couple
pushed into the leg side towards Kartik
appeal for run-out, short on the off, guided to short third, Mishra wants a single but is sent back, a good throw to the non-striker's end and Kartik takes down the stumps but he's made it
flighted on middle and leg, turned into the leg side past midwicket, does so gently, and has enough time to come back for the second
spoils what began as a tidy over, short on the off, comes down the track and pulls it away hard over midwicket for another boundary, these two are doing well to keep Deccan on track here
shortish on middle, too straight, Mishra flicks it away uppishly through square, fine leg is up and he fetches four
short of a good length on the off, pushes it straight to extra cover
low full toss on middle, driven to long-on for a single
the ball's not coming on, slower one again, shortish on the off, Gibs wants to mow it over midwicket but can't connect well enough
a slower bouncer this time but too high, called a wide
a slower one bowled short outside off, Gibbs comes down the track to smack that over his head, misses
and once more, almost the same shot from Mishra, comes down the pitch and lofts over mid-on for four more
down the track this time and lofts the ball over mid-on for a one-bounce four
driven firmly down to mid-on
looks to sweep, but is struck on the pads outside legstump, ball dribbles towards backward square leg
Gibbs makes room and elegantly cuts the ball to the point boundary, wonderful timing on that
defended towards cover, Gibbs wants a run but is rightly sent back
again a boundary off the last ball of the over, cracked in front of point for four by Mishra
looks for a massive hit over midwicket, it was short of a length and just outside off, batsman misses the ball completely
short of length, pitching just outside off, Mishra charges down the pitch and throws his bat at it, mistimes drive to mid-on
swung away towards deep square leg for a single
a touch slower from Agarkar, 123 kmh, Gibbs was expecting the ball to rise more than it did, Gibbs' mow meets only air and the ball sails over middle stump
full and outside off, Gibbs works the ball towards midwicket
lovely shot to finish the over, a touch short outside off, Mishra jabs it past the keeper for four, too fine for third man to have a chance
pushed towards mid-on for a single this time
shortish ball, 142.1kmh, Gibbs was charging down the track, checks his shot and the ball nearly pops back to the bowler
back of a length, just outside off, defended towards cover, steal a quick single
a touch short, worked away behind square leg for a couple
fullish and on the pads, clipped towards mid-on for a single
length ball just outside off, defended solidly towards the left of the bowler
pushed towards cover for a sharp single

a massive wicket for Kolkata, Gilchrist looks to mow the ball over midwicket, gets the ball high on the bat, the ball swirls towards deep midwicket, Pujara runs in from the rope to safely take the catch, it looked like there would be a collision with Gayle who was running from inside the circle, but there was no problems in the end, Eden goes crazy
just outside off, Gilchrist wanted to get another boundary by dabbing it past short third man, but he can't beat the fielder there
fuller this time, no difference in the result, Gilchrist whacks it to the right of the bowler, the ball races away for four
a touch short and Gilchrist latches onto it, swings cleanly over wide mid-on for a one-bounce four
short of a good length on the off, drops it in front of point, good comeback after that six
short of a good length on middle, tries to turn it into the leg side, is struck high on the pads
slides it down the leg side, a slower ball gone wrong, a wide
turned just wide of short fine who gets behind it well to keep them to a single
missed run-out, Gilchrist is lucky, played to midwicket and rush for a single, Gayle fielded and tool aim at the striker's end but didn't strike, Gilchrist was a gonner had that hit
what a reply, Bond drags it short outside off, Gibbs charges down the track and slaps it hard over extra cover to clear the ropes
beats Gibbs straightaway, short of a good length, moving away, a legcutter, goes past the outside edge as Gibbs tries to open the face
on middle and leg, turned behind square for a single to keep the strike, Deccan have begun well
delicately done, slower through the air, Gibbs gets on the front foot, waits for it to turn in and late-cuts it past short third man for the third four of the over
turning in from a good length outside off, guided towards short third
poor delivery, short on middle, long hop, pulled away powerfully through square leg for another boundary
Gibbs doesn't waste much time, angling it on middle, swept hard through square leg, beat the gap between him and short fine leg, gets a boundary
short and down the leg side, concedes a wide
flighted on middle, pushed straight to midwicket
